europe_now.title: Poland Detains Man Suspected of Planning Assassination of PM Tusk
europe_now.summary: Polish authorities have detained a man suspected of plotting an assassination against Prime Minister Donald Tusk. Prime Minister Tusk stated that recent stabbings in the country were driven by the online glorification of violence.

sources.headline: Poland detains man suspected of planning assassination of PM Tusk
Poland stabbings driven by online glorification of violence, Tusk says

europe_now.title: Trump Announces Energy Ceasefire Between Russia and Ukraine
europe_now.summary: Former US President Donald Trump claimed that Russia and Ukraine have agreed to an energy ceasefire. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky responded that the announcement was news to him while Russia remained silent.

sources.headline: Trump's 'energy ceasefire' claim welcomed by Zelensky but Russia silent
Trump says Ukraine and Russia have agreed 'energy ceasefire'

top_stories.title: French Left-Wing Primary
top_stories.summary: MEP Raphaël Glucksmann has won the French center-left primary election. He secured the nomination with 66 percent of the vote to become a candidate for the presidency.

sources.headline: MEP Glucksmann wins French center-left primary, becoming candidate for presidency
🔴 Raphaël Glucksmann wins French left-wing primary with 66% of vote

top_stories.title: Kraków Mayoral Election
top_stories.summary: An independent candidate defeated the candidate backed by Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk in the Kraków mayoral election. The runoff result marks a political setback for the prime minister.
